title: TracePoint error envelope
description: The single JSON document written to stdout when a command run with --output json fails, and the body of a failed REST or MCP operation. Exactly one of this or a success document is emitted. Codes are stable: renaming one is a breaking change. The full registry is in docs/ERRORS.md and in the capabilities manifest.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable identifier. Branch on this, never on the message.

message.description: One sentence describing what went wrong, in lower case and without a trailing period.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the offending location in the input document, when the error is about a document.

line.description: 1-based line in the source file, when known.

column.description: 1-based column in the source file, when known.

hint.description: What to do about it, concretely. Present whenever a fix can be named.

exit_code.description: Exit code the CLI used or would use for this error: 2 usage, config or policy refusal; 3 preflight or runtime failure; 4 run invalid; 5 wait timed out.

retriable.description: Whether repeating the identical call could plausibly succeed. Configuration and policy errors are never retriable.

run_id.description: Run this error belongs to, when it happened inside a run.

details.description: Further structured context, shaped per code. Never contains secrets or response bodies.

causes.description: Additional errors of the same shape when several independent problems were found at once, as when a configuration has many invalid fields. The top-level error summarises them.
